description: Extract readable fields from a PNG, JPEG, or WebP invoice, receipt, form, screenshot, label, or photographed document into guaranteed schema-valid JSON. This hosted service is V2-only and always paid from the first call; there is no free or V1 image endpoint. A locally configured SCHEMASURE_PRIVATE_KEY signs x402 V2 USDC payments on Base by default; set SCHEMASURE_PAYMENT_PROTOCOL=mpp for direct Tempo USDC.e payments. The key never leaves this process. Add per-field schema descriptions for best accuracy.

data.description: Base64 bytes without a data-URL prefix.

schema.description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) that the returned `data` is guaranteed to satisfy.

name: extract_image_to_schema
